source_observations: CCR computes a deterministic 24-hex-character (96-bit) BLAKE3 prefix key for payloads.
CcrStore.get returns None when recovery material is missing or expired.
Default TTL is 1800 seconds and an absolute max lifetime caps sliding retention.
SQLite writes upsert by hash key and replace the prior payload at that key.
SQLite put failures are logged after the marker may already have been embedded; the source explicitly accepts degradation to an unrecoverable original rather than failing the compression path closed.
Upstream roundtrip tests demonstrate byte/JSON recovery for successful in-memory store paths, but those tests do not erase the missing/expired/write-failure semantics above.

bounded_discriminator.important_limit: The local surface had no Rust toolchain, so upstream Rust code was not executed. This is not E3 upstream runtime reproduction.

strongest_interpretation: Headroom CCR is a useful donor for reversible model-facing context compression only as a temporary noncanonical cache. Its current source contract is insufficient for F2 canonical/evidence-bearing omission because recovery write failure, expiry, or key replacement can leave a marker whose original is no longer verifiably recoverable.
skeptical_counterinterpretation: For ordinary short-lived model context, bounded TTL and best-effort recovery may be entirely appropriate; a 96-bit content key is probabilistically ample for a bounded cache, and upstream successful-path roundtrip tests support the intended product scope. The mismatch is primarily an F2 authority/evidence requirement mismatch, not evidence that Headroom's own design is defective.

portable_primitives: separate compressed view from stored original
required_f2_fences: commit recovery material successfully before emitting any omission marker
bind full canonical original digest plus provenance/generation identity
on retrieve, recompute and verify digest before re-entry
missing/expired/mismatched recovery material => UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN/fail closed, never silently continue as lossless
canonical evidence remains in UnifiedDB; compressed ContextView is rebuildable projection only
retention must be tied to ContextView/evidence lifetime rather than an implicit short cache TTL

stop_condition: Do not spend another Trigger-6 slot on generic Headroom CCR source reading. Next useful discriminator is either exact upstream Rust execution at the bound commit or an F2-native fail-closed recovery-commit prototype/test owned by the relevant implementation workpackage.
